🚨Alert: Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases rising in China!🦠
Key symptoms to watch:
😷Cough
🤒Fever
🤧Runny nose
⚡️Breathing difficulty
High risk:Children & elderly 👶🏽👴🏽
